verses.en: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,
verses.pt: Enquanto eles estavam falando ao povo, sobrevieram-lhes os sacerdotes, o capitão do templo e os saduceus,
verses.en_web: As they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them,
verses.en_bbe: And while they were talking to the people, the priests and the captain of the Temple and the Sadducees came up to them,

verses.en: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
verses.pt: doendo-se muito de que eles ensinassem o povo, e anunciassem em Jesus a ressurreição dentre os mortos,
verses.en_web: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
verses.en_bbe: Being greatly troubled because they were teaching the people and preaching Jesus as an example of the coming back from the dead.

verses.en: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.
verses.pt: deitaram mão neles, e os encerraram na prisão até o dia seguinte; pois era já tarde.
verses.en_web: They laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.
verses.en_bbe: And they took them and put them in prison till the morning, for it was now evening.

verses.en: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.
verses.pt: Muitos, porém, dos que ouviram a palavra, creram, e se elevou o número dos homens a quase cinco mil.
verses.en_web: But many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.
verses.en_bbe: But a number of those who gave hearing to the word had faith; and they were now about five thousand.

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,
verses.pt: No dia seguinte, reuniram-se em Jerusalém as autoridades, os anciãos, os escribas,
verses.en_web: In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: And on the day after, the rulers and those in authority and the scribes came together in Jerusalem;

verses.en: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.
verses.pt: e Anás, o sumo sacerdote, e Caifás, João, Alexandre, e todos quantos eram da linhagem do sumo sacerdote.
verses.en_web: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.
verses.en_bbe: And Annas, the high priest, was there, and Caiaphas and John and Alexander, and all the relations of the high priest.

verses.en: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?
verses.pt: E, pondo-os no meio deles, perguntaram: Com que poder ou em nome de quem fizestes vós isto?
verses.en_web: When they had stood Peter and John in the middle of them, they inquired, “By what power, or in what name, have you done this?”
verses.en_bbe: Then sending for Peter and John, they said, By what power and in whose name have you done this?

verses.en: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,
verses.pt: Então Pedro, cheio do Espírito Santo, lhes disse: Autoridades do povo e vós, anciãos,
verses.en_web: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “You rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,
verses.en_bbe: Then Peter, being full of the Holy Spirit, said to them, O you rulers of the people and men of authority,

verses.en: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;
verses.pt: se nós hoje somos inquiridos acerca do benefício feito a um enfermo, e do modo como foi curado,
verses.en_web: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man, by what means this man has been healed,
verses.en_bbe: If we are questioned today about a good work done to a man who was ill, as to how he has been made well,

verses.en: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.
verses.pt: seja conhecido de vós todos, e de todo o povo de Israel, que em nome de Jesus Cristo, o nazareno, aquele a quem vós crucificastes e a quem Deus ressuscitou dentre os mortos, nesse nome está este aqui, são diante de vós.
verses.en_web: be it known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, in him does this man stand here before you whole.
verses.en_bbe: Take note, all of you, and all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you put to death on the cross, whom God gave back from the dead, even through him is this man now before you completely well.

verses.en: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.
verses.pt: Ele é a pedra que foi rejeitada por vós, os edificadores, a qual foi posta como pedra angular.
verses.en_web: He is ‘the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.’
verses.en_bbe: He is the stone which you builders had no use for, but which has been made the chief stone of the building.

verses.en: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.
verses.pt: E em nenhum outro há salvação; porque debaixo do céu nenhum outro nome há, dado entre os homens, em que devamos ser salvos.
verses.en_web: There is salvation in none other, for neither is there any other name under heaven, that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”
verses.en_bbe: And in no other is there salvation: for there is no other name under heaven, given among men, through which we may have salvation.

verses.en: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
verses.pt: Então eles, vendo a intrepidez de Pedro e João, e tendo percebido que eram homens iletrados e indoutos, se admiravam; e reconheciam que haviam estado com Jesus.
verses.en_web: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled. They recognized that they had been with Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: Now when they saw that Peter and John were without fear, though they were men of no education or learning, they were greatly surprised; and they took note of them that they had been with Jesus.

verses.en: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
verses.pt: E vendo em pé com eles o homem que fora curado, nada tinham que dizer em contrário.
verses.en_web: Seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
verses.en_bbe: And, seeing that the man who had been made well was there with them, they were not able to say anything against it.

verses.en: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
verses.pt: Todavia, mandando-os sair do sinédrio, conferenciaram entre si,
verses.en_web: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
verses.en_bbe: But when they had given them orders to go out of the Sanhedrin, they had a discussion among themselves,

verses.en: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.
verses.pt: dizendo: Que havemos de fazer a estes homens? porque a todos os que habitam em Jerusalém é manifesto que por eles foi feito um sinal notório, e não o podemos negar.
verses.en_web: saying, “What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we can’t deny it.
verses.en_bbe: Saying, What are we to do with these men? for certainly it is clear to all who are living in Jerusalem that a most important sign has been done by them, and it is not possible to say that it is not so.

verses.en: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.
verses.pt: Mas, para que não se divulgue mais entre o povo, ameacemo- los para que de ora em diante não falem neste nome a homem algum.
verses.en_web: But so that this spreads no further among the people, let’s threaten them, that from now on they don’t speak to anyone in this name.”
verses.en_bbe: But so that it may not go farther among the people, let us put them in fear of punishment if they say anything in future in this name.

verses.en: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
verses.pt: E, chamando-os, ordenaram-lhes que absolutamente não falassem nem ensinassem em nome de Jesus.
verses.en_web: They called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: And they sent for them, and gave them orders not to make statements or give teaching in the name of Jesus.

verses.en: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.
verses.pt: Mas Pedro e João, respondendo, lhes disseram: Julgai vós se é justo diante de Deus ouvir-nos antes a vós do que a Deus;
verses.en_web: But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves,
verses.en_bbe: But Peter and John in answer said to them, It is for you to say if it is right in the eyes of God to give attention to you more than to God:

verses.en: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.
verses.pt: pois nós não podemos deixar de falar das coisas que temos visto e ouvido.
verses.en_web: for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”
verses.en_bbe: For it is not possible for us to keep from saying what we have seen and have knowledge of.

verses.en: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.
verses.pt: Mas eles ainda os ameaçaram mais, e, não achando motivo para os castigar, soltaram-nos, por causa do povo; porque todos glorificavam a Deus pelo que acontecera;
verses.en_web: When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for everyone glorified God for that which was done.
verses.en_bbe: And when they had said more sharp words to them, they let them go, not seeing what punishment they might give them, because of the people; for all men were giving praise to God for what had taken place.

verses.en: For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.
verses.pt: pois tinha mais de quarenta anos o homem em quem se operara esta cura milagrosa.
verses.en_web: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.
verses.en_bbe: For the man on whom this act of power was done was more than forty years old.

verses.en: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.
verses.pt: E soltos eles, foram para os seus, e contaram tudo o que lhes haviam dito os principais sacerdotes e os anciãos.
verses.en_web: Being let go, they came to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.
verses.en_bbe: And when they had been made free, they came back to their friends, and gave an account of all the things which the chief priests and the authorities had said to them.

verses.en: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:
verses.pt: Ao ouvirem isto, levantaram unanimemente a voz a Deus e disseram: Senhor, tu que fizeste o céu, a terra, o mar, e tudo o que neles há;
verses.en_web: When they heard it, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, “O Lord, you are God, who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;
verses.en_bbe: And hearing it, they all, with one mind, made prayer to God and said, O Lord, maker of heaven and earth and the sea and all things in them:

verses.en: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?
verses.pt: que pelo Espírito Santo, por boca de nosso pai Davi, teu servo, disseste: Por que se enfureceram os gentios, e os povos imaginaram coisas vãs?
verses.en_web: who by the mouth of your servant, David, said, ‘Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
verses.en_bbe: Who has said, by the Holy Spirit, through the mouth of our father David your servant, Why are the nations so violently moved, and why are the thoughts of the people so foolish?

verses.en: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.
verses.pt: Levantaram-se os reis da terra, e as autoridades ajuntaram- se à uma, contra o Senhor e contra o seu Ungido.
verses.en_web: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take council together, against the Lord, and against his Christ.’
verses.en_bbe: The kings of the earth were lifted up, the rulers came together, against the Lord, and against his Christ:

verses.en: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,
verses.pt: Porque verdadeiramente se ajuntaram, nesta cidade, contra o teu santo Servo Jesus, ao qual ungiste, não só Herodes, mas também Pôncio Pilatos com os gentios e os povos de Israel;
verses.en_web: “For truly, in this city against your holy servant, Jesus, whom you anointed, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together
verses.en_bbe: For, truly, in this town, against your holy servant, Jesus, who was marked out by you as Christ, Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, came together,

verses.en: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.
verses.pt: para fazerem tudo o que a tua mão e o teu conselho predeterminaram que se fizesse.
verses.en_web: to do whatever your hand and your council foreordained to happen.
verses.en_bbe: To do that which had been fixed before by your hand and your purpose.

verses.en: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,
verses.pt: Agora pois, ó Senhor, olha para as suas ameaças, e concede aos teus servos que falam com toda a intrepidez a tua palavra,
verses.en_web: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,
verses.en_bbe: And now, Lord, take note of their cruel words, and give your servants power to be preachers of your word without fear,

verses.en: By stretching forth thine hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus.
verses.pt: enquanto estendes a mão para curar e para que se façam sinais e prodígios pelo nome de teu santo Servo Jesus.
verses.en_web: while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant Jesus.”
verses.en_bbe: While your hand is stretched out to do works of mercy; so that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy servant Jesus.

verses.en: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.
verses.pt: E, tendo eles orado, tremeu o lugar em que estavam reunidos; e todos foram cheios do Espírito Santo, e anunciavam com intrepidez a palavra de Deus.
verses.en_web: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.
verses.en_bbe: And when their prayer was ended, the place where they were was violently moved, and they all became full of the Holy Spirit, preaching the word of God without fear.

verses.en: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.
verses.pt: Da multidão dos que criam, era um só o coração e uma só a alma, e ninguém dizia que coisa alguma das que possuía era sua própria, mas todas as coisas lhes eram comuns.
verses.en_web: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.
verses.en_bbe: And all those who were of the faith were one in heart and soul: and not one of them said that any of the things which he had was his property only; but they had all things in common.

verses.en: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.
verses.pt: Com grande poder os apóstolos davam testemunho da ressurreição do Senhor Jesus, e em todos eles havia abundante graça.
verses.en_web: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.
verses.en_bbe: And with great power the Apostles gave witness of the coming back of the Lord Jesus from the dead; and grace was on them all.

verses.en: Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,
verses.pt: Pois não havia entre eles necessitado algum; porque todos os que possuíam terras ou casas, vendendo-as, traziam o preço do que vendiam e o depositavam aos pés dos apóstolos.
verses.en_web: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,
verses.en_bbe: And no one among them was in need; for everyone who had land or houses, exchanging them for money, took the price of them,

verses.en: And laid them down at the apostles’ feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.
verses.pt: E se repartia a qualquer um que tivesse necessidade.
verses.en_web: and laid them at the apostles’ feet, and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.
verses.en_bbe: And put it at the feet of the Apostles for distribution to everyone as he had need.

verses.en: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,
verses.pt: então José, cognominado pelos apóstolos Barnabé (que quer dizer, filho de consolação), levita, natural de Chipre,
verses.en_web: Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,
verses.en_bbe: And Joseph, who was given by the Apostles the name of Barnabas (the sense of which is, Son of comfort), a Levite and a man of Cyprus by birth,

verses.en: Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
verses.pt: possuindo um campo, vendeu-o, trouxe o preço e o depositou aos pés dos apóstolos.
verses.en_web: having a field, sold it, and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
verses.en_bbe: Having a field, got money for it and put the money at the feet of the Apostles.
